
---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Gina Cepeda"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot

storms |>
  # Keep only tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  # Order status from weakest to strongest so the legend and colors match
  mutate(
    status = factor(
      status,
      levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")
    )
  ) |>
  # Keep one row per storm name and status in each year
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  # Count the number of storms of each type per year
  count(year, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Storms per Year by Type",
    subtitle = "Atlantic hurricane database (1975–2022)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type",
    caption = "Source: NOAA / dplyr::storms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-data

storms_recent <- storms |>
  #| cache: true
  # Keep only storm observations from the year 2000 onward
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  # Keep only the columns of interest
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-wind-plot

storms_recent |>
  # Map wind speed to x, pressure to y, and storm status to color
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  # Use alpha to make overlapping points semi-transparent
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Stronger Winds Correspond to Lower Atmospheric Pressure",
    subtitle = "Atlantic storm observations by status (2000–2022)",
    x = "Maximum Sustained Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Atmospheric Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status",
    caption = "Source: NOAA / dplyr::storms"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
